answer: Each key must maintain a dedicated 1-GiB trusted-memory region for 12 epochs and answer nine beacon-derived random reads per epoch within 250 ms. Validators verify enclave counters and compare page-fault fingerprints; keys sharing 8 of 9 rare faults are merged. A mirror may hang above a ledge beside a willow, but every extra fake needs another live region and 108 timely proofs, so 1,000 clones reserve 1 TiB and answer 108,000 reads. Two missed rounds erase rewards, slash a 90-credit bond, and freeze the cluster for five epochs.
